product_overview: DeelRxCRM is a mobile-first CRM, POS, and inventory management system designed for regulated, inventory-driven small businesses, focusing on financial accuracy, inventory traceability, role-based accountability, operational speed on mobile devices, and auditability.
core_goals: Ensure financial correctness with immutable transaction records and strict audit logging.
Maintain inventory traceability with immutable historical data and accurate cost accounting.
Enforce role-based access controls server-side to avoid unauthorized actions.
Enable efficient, one-handed mobile POS operations.
Support privacy compliance with right-to-be-forgotten (RTBF) data removal and masking.
key_features: Fast and mobile-optimized POS supporting fractional sales, price overrides with role validation, and tax inclusivity/exclusivity.
Comprehensive inventory management with intake recording, derived cost per unit, and audit-logged adjustments.
Robust pricing and tax logic with deterministic rules, configurable tax per business, and explicit rounding.
CRM functionalities including customer profiles with purchase history, notes, and status flags, with soft-disabling instead of deletion.
Detailed reporting and audit logs capturing sensitive actions such as price overrides, inventory changes, voids, refunds, and permissions modifications.
Team management API enforcing strict role hierarchies to control user permissions and role assignment.
Audit logs API providing tenant-isolated, filterable audit trail access for user actions and business events.
RTBF Deletion API for permanent PII masking and tenant role removals to ensure privacy compliance.
user_flow_summary: User logs into the system and accesses the POS interface optimized for mobile touch inputs.
Cashier completes sales with possible fractional quantities and role-validated price overrides.
Supervisor and Manager roles perform overrides, void transactions, and inventory adjustments with audit logging.
Managers manage product catalogs, pricing, taxes, customers, and suppliers through dedicated interfaces.
Super Admin manages users, roles, permissions, business configurations, and audit log access.
Users request audit logs filtered by tenant, action, type, and date through the Audit Logs API.
Team administrators add or update team members while hierarchy enforcement prevents improper role assignments.
Users initiate RTBF deletion requests via API to mask PII and remove tenant roles for privacy.
validation_criteria: All sales transactions are immutable and generate immutable audit trails.
Inventory adjustments are logged with timestamps and user context; historical data remains unchanged.
Role enforcement is validated at the database level, preventing unauthorized permission changes.
Audit logs are append-only, accessible only by authorized roles, and support complex filtering.
RTBF deletion correctly masks all PII fields and removes tenant roles without residual data.
Mobile POS workflows tested for usability, enabling sale completion in under two minutes by new staff.
System rejects unauthorized role assignments and invalid team membership actions.
No unlogged financial changes occur; all sensitive changes are verifiably logged.
